description: Capitalism has helped create extraordinary innovation, new industries, millions of businesses, and opportunities for generations of Americans. Entrepreneurship and competition should remain fundamental parts of our economy. But capitalism works best when there are rules, competition is real, workers have opportunities to advance, consumers are protected, and corporations are held accountable for their actions. I
